steps.title: Portal Authentication
steps.description: Student authenticates to CampXSync with authorized student session

steps.title: Navigate to Student Documents Desk
steps.description: Student documents workspace loaded with checklist and active submissions tabs

steps.title: Switch to My Submissions Tab
steps.description: View student's committed document records, versions, retention policies, and expiry warnings

steps.title: Verify Expiry Badges & Retention Policies
steps.description: System detects document expiration thresholds: EXPIRING SOON (<30d) and EXPIRED badges rendered with retention policy codes

steps.title: Inspect Regulatory Audit Trail
steps.description: Click 'Audit Trail' button on the document to open the regulatory access history modal

steps.title: Verify Regulatory Details & Empty Initial Log
steps.description: Audit modal displays document retention policy (RET_10_YEARS), calculated expiry date, and access history

steps.title: Trigger Regulatory Download & Access Log
steps.description: Student clicks 'Download & Record Access' button, dispatching POST /api/v1/documents/:id/access-log through API Gateway into doc.document_deliveries

steps.title: Verify Live Committed Regulatory Delivery Log
steps.description: Regulatory access entry appears live in the audit table with Channel DOWNLOAD, Status DOWNLOADED, and client IP

steps.title: Close Audit Modal
steps.description: Close audit modal and return to submissions overview

steps.title: PostgreSQL Database committed check
steps.description: Read-only query verifies doc.document_deliveries has committed the audit log record with channel DOWNLOAD and status DOWNLOADED
steps.query: SELECT id, channel, status, client_ip FROM doc.document_deliveries WHERE document_id = '11111111-0006-0000-0000-000000000001' AND channel = 'DOWNLOAD' AND status = 'DOWNLOADED'

steps.title: Negative RBAC Enforcement Check
steps.description: API Gateway and Document Service reject unauthenticated/unauthorized access to document audit trail with HTTP 401/403
